observations: Photo 0: A used engine block with attached transmission/gearbox, long metal shaft visible, lying on bare ground; wiring harness and hoses still attached; some corrosion and dirt visible; blue and green paint marks on casing; watermark reads 'POSTED ON JIJI GEARUP INC.'

Photo 1: Several more used engine and transmission assemblies piled together in a yard; a person's leg and shoe visible standing among the parts; intake manifolds, wiring, and bare metal casings visible; same watermark present.

Photo 2: Close-up of the same engine and transmission unit as photo 0, showing exhaust manifold flanges, bolts, and attached cables; ground is concrete with dirt and oil stains; same watermark visible.
